subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: How should maintainers split this umbrella across dashboard auth recovery, Codex/OpenAI OAuth migration, installer/runtime atomicity, final-turn delivery, and context hygiene?
rationale: The remaining work crosses multiple ownership and security-sensitive surfaces, and choosing one broad core repair would risk mixing unrelated upgrade, auth, and session-state contracts.

options.title: Split Into Canonical Subissues
options.body: Keep this issue open as the routing umbrella only long enough to ensure each remaining surface has a narrow owner and linked issue or PR.

options.title: Keep As Tracking Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as a parent tracker for the whole reliability theme, accepting that it will not be a safe automated fix lane.

options.title: Close After Narrow Links
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers confirm the linked narrower items preserve all useful reporter evidence and own the remaining work.

recommendation.title: Split Into Canonical Subissues
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the routing umbrella only long enough to ensure each remaining surface has a narrow owner and linked issue or PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent merged history on the final-turn/session liveness part and is the best available routing owner among the inspected related work.
